PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Kantor Surabaya

Execution Import Document Staff

Job Responsibilities

• Manage and execute import documentation processes, including preparation, review, verification, and filing of import-related documents.
• Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of import documents with applicable international trade regulations, customs requirements, and company procedures.
• Review and verify import documentation such as commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading/airway bills, certificates of origin, customs documents, and other supporting documents.
• Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, shipping agents, and internal stakeholders to ensure the timely processing of import shipments and documentation.
• Monitor the status and progress of import shipments and related documentation and follow up on outstanding documents or issues.
• Support the preparation and submission of documents required for customs clearance and import activities.
• Identify and follow up on discrepancies, incomplete documents, or potential issues that may affect the import process.
• Maintain accurate and organized records and documentation of import activities for tracking, reporting, audit, and compliance purposes.
• Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure the availability of required information and documents for import transactions.
• Assist in monitoring logistics activities and shipment schedules to support smooth and timely import operations.
• Maintain effective communication and professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders involved in import and logistics activities.
• Prepare routine reports and provide updates regarding the status of import documentation and shipments.
• Ensure all import documentation activities are carried out in accordance with company policies, procedures, and applicable laws and regulations.
• Perform other duties and responsibilities related to import documentation and logistics activities as assigned by the Supervisor/Manager.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, International Business, Logistics, Management or a related field.
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; candidates with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience are preferred.
• Good knowledge of international trade regulations, customs regulations, and import procedures.
• Good understanding of import documentation and customs clearance processes.
• Ability to prepare, review, verify, and maintain import and export documentation accurately.
• Good coordination and organizational skills, particularly in managing logistics activities and documentation.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies or incomplete documentation.
• Good interpersonal and communication skills to establish and maintain effective relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
• Good English communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly for handling international correspondence and documentation.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
• Able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
• Able to work under deadlines and manage multiple documentation and logistics activities simultaneously.
• High level of integrity, accuracy, responsibility, and attention to detail.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Kantor Surabaya

Execution Import Document Staff

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Mengelola dan melaksanakan proses dokumentasi impor, meliputi penyusunan, pemeriksaan, verifikasi, dan pengarsipan dokumen terkait kegiatan impor.
• Memastikan keakuratan, kelengkapan, dan kepatuhan dokumen impor terhadap peraturan perdagangan internasional, ketentuan kepabeanan, dan prosedur perusahaan yang berlaku.
• Memeriksa dan memverifikasi dokumen impor, seperti faktur komersial (commercial invoice), daftar kemasan (packing list), bill of lading/airway bill, surat keterangan asal (certificate of origin), dokumen kepabeanan, serta dokumen pendukung lainnya.
• Melakukan koordinasi dengan freight forwarder, customs broker, pemasok, agen pelayaran, dan pihak internal terkait untuk memastikan proses pengiriman dan dokumentasi impor terlaksana secara tepat waktu.
• Memantau status dan perkembangan pengiriman impor beserta dokumen terkait serta melakukan tindak lanjut terhadap dokumen yang belum lengkap atau permasalahan yang ditemukan.
• Mendukung proses penyusunan dan penyampaian dokumen yang diperlukan untuk proses customs clearance (pengeluaran barang melalui kepabeanan) dan kegiatan impor.
• Mengidentifikasi dan menindaklanjuti ketidaksesuaian, ketidaklengkapan dokumen, atau potensi permasalahan yang dapat menghambat proses impor.
• Memelihara pencatatan dan pengarsipan dokumen kegiatan impor secara akurat dan terorganisasi untuk keperluan pemantauan, pelaporan, audit, dan kepatuhan.
• Melakukan koordinasi dengan departemen terkait untuk memastikan ketersediaan informasi dan dokumen yang diperlukan dalam transaksi impor.
• Membantu memantau kegiatan logistik dan jadwal pengiriman untuk mendukung kelancaran dan ketepatan waktu proses impor.
• Menjaga komunikasi dan hubungan kerja yang efektif dan profesional dengan pihak internal maupun eksternal yang terlibat dalam kegiatan impor dan logistik.
• Menyusun laporan secara berkala serta memberikan informasi terkini mengenai status dokumentasi dan pengiriman impor.
• Memastikan seluruh kegiatan dokumentasi impor dilaksanakan sesuai dengan kebijakan, prosedur perusahaan, serta peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.
• Melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab lainnya yang berkaitan dengan dokumentasi impor dan kegiatan logistik sesuai dengan arahan Supervisor/Manajer.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Manajemen Rantai Pasok, Bisnis Internasional, Logistik, Manajemen, atau bidang terkait.
• Lulusan baru dipersilakan melamar; kandidat dengan pengalaman kerja yang relevan minimal 2 tahun lebih diutamakan.
• Memiliki pengetahuan yang baik mengenai peraturan perdagangan internasional, ketentuan kepabeanan, dan prosedur impor.
• Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai dokumentasi impor dan proses customs clearance.
• Mampu menyusun, memeriksa, memverifikasi, dan mengelola dokumen impor dan ekspor secara akurat.
• Memiliki kemampuan koordinasi dan pengorganisasian yang baik, khususnya dalam mengelola kegiatan logistik dan dokumentasi.
• Memiliki ketelitian yang tinggi serta mampu mengidentifikasi ketidaksesuaian atau ketidaklengkapan dokumen.
• Memiliki kemampuan interpersonal dan komunikasi yang baik untuk membangun serta menjaga hubungan kerja yang efektif dengan freight forwarder, customs broker, pemasok, dan pihak internal terkait.
• Memiliki kemampuan berbahasa Inggris yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tulisan, khususnya dalam menangani komunikasi dan dokumentasi internasional.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, khususnya Microsoft Excel dan Microsoft Word.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim.
• Mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu dan mengelola beberapa kegiatan dokumentasi serta logistik secara bersamaan.
• Memiliki integritas, ketelitian, tanggung jawab, dan perhatian terhadap detail yang tinggi.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
